title: Are We Worse Off After Policy Repeals? Evidence from Two Green Policies
eligible_reason: Main method is Bayesian synthetic control (BSCM, horseshoe prior) run separately for each treated city and policy (Austin ban: implementation then repeal announced July 11 2018; Dallas $.05 fee: Jan 1 2015 start, repealed June 2015; also Seattle and Washington DC implementation) against 14-15 control cities. Synthetic control is excluded by the protocol, and there is no pooled TWFE or event study with unit and time FE. Generalized synthetic control (Xu 2017) is only a robustness check.
design_notes: Unit: city-week (first three zip digits, 22 cities), outcome = standard-normalised trash bag quantity sales and price from NielsenIQ Retail Scanner. Effects reported as percentage gaps with 95% credible intervals; placebo in time and in space; random-effects meta-analysis over placebos.
estimators_reported: Bayesian lasso / elastic net benchmark models
screener_notes: Ineligible: synthetic control per treated city; no TWFE. Data: NielsenIQ Retail Scanner (Kilts, licensed); no package in batch.
